summary: Retain definition, criteria, actual paired scores and identities in parity evidence; record requested and effective k and bind normalized supplied inputs using a permutation-invariant canonical digest. Decision NONE.
API: qualification.rerank_parity.analyze_rerank_parity(mapping_or_ParityInput); module docstring defines input, output, limits and digest payload. Result input_binding uses schema.fingerprint over versioned sorted supplied pair identities, digests, scores, definition, executions and criteria.
limitations: SUPPLIED_UNVERIFIED synthetic values only. The digest binds declarations and scores, not actual execution or artifact authenticity. No model, GPU, service or hardware qualification; no CLI/file loader, push, PR or merge.
